IGUI_NE_Report_Title: Confidential Document: NOX:EVOLVED Report & Sample Transfer Plan
IGUI_NE_Report_Intro: Contacts in the military say the total airstrike is in about 50 days. Exceeding initial predictions, the virus has begun to 'evolve' rapidly. Corpses are transforming, and the environment itself is being contaminated. I wanted to transfer you to the airport and save you... but we were surrounded here. Putting you to sleep for 5 years to adapt was not an experiment, but my personal decision to let you survive this hell. Forgive me.
IGUI_NE_Report_Mission: I can no longer move. To keep your 'mutation' below critical levels, head to the terminal in the deepest part of the military research facility. There may be a final means to stabilize your body and a code to prevent the total airstrike. The four access keys and the samples to stabilize your body have been stolen from the military and hidden in my underground bases at each location.
IGUI_NE_Report_Note: *A military cleanup squad (SWAT) has been deployed. They leave no witnesses. Be careful.
